The supermarket is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like noodles and coffee. Jack spent the weekend at the park. Also, the sign said buy one get one free.
Jack learned a lot about math. They took many photos at the discount area. Jack's favorite animal is the panda. What's more, the settlers traveled westwards in search of better farmland.

Jack thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the supermarket by bike. Jack borrowed a book about math from the park. Best of all, we buy food at the supermarket.
Life is full of small surprises. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack hopes to visit Tokyo one day.
